description: Materials Project perovskites, grounded recipe: the screening model of round 2.
config_text:
# MEIDNet trained on the Materials Project corner-sharing perovskite set (919 structures, 5-20 atoms, many prototypes):
# the "user uploads their own dataset" test of the general pipeline (2026-10-07).  mp_grounded: seed 0, structure-only losses 1.0.
name: mp_grounded
description: "mp_grounded: MP perovskites, site_order roles, cgcnn descriptors, periodic encoder, max_sites 20, structure losses 1.0"
output_dir: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_fix/runs/mp_grounded/out
data:
  table: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_data/mp_perovskites/intake/train.csv
  val_table: /gpfs/scratch/acad/catalys/ababu/meidnet_data/mp_perovskites/intake/val.csv
  id_column: material_id
  cif_column: cif
  properties:
    - {column: formation_energy_per_atom, label: Formation energy, unit: eV/atom, normalize: true}
    - {column: band_gap,                  label: Band gap,         unit: eV,      normalize: true}
  max_sites: 20
  site_order: roles           # A-type cations (largest site) first, then B, then anions: from geometry, any cell size
  align_to_prototype: false
model:
  decoder_coordinate_input: zeros
  periodic_encoder: true
  element_features: cgcnn
training:
  epochs: 300
  batch_size: 64
  learning_rate: 0.001
  seed: 0
  device: cpu
  save_every: 50
  loss_weights: {structure_reconstruction: 1.0, structure_property: 1.0}
